_provenance: End dates for timeline banners released before 2023-08-17 that lacked an 'until' (ids 9200*/9300*, post-2023-08-17 banners, and authored/undated rows such as 11 and 75 excluded). Sources read 2026-11-12: Fandom wiki via api.php (Summon/2016, Summon/2017, Summon/2019, One_Year_Anniversary,_Kupo!, 40M_DL_Celebration_Quests, 40M_DL_Step-Up_Summon_Ticket, Events, Festival_of_the_Autumn_Moon, Demons_Unleashed) and saved wiki pages in ios-server/research/wiki (Orbonne_Monastery_Vaults, The_Giant_of_Babel, explorations/Into_the_Abyss). Summon/2016 lists no 'Available Until' for banners before 2016-10-21; Reddit and the Wayback Machine were unreachable. Where no end was found, until = release + default_days[kind] - 1; default_days is the median inclusive release..until length of same-kind timeline banners that have both dates (select has none, so it uses the featured median). Early-2016 featured defaults of 14 days fit the two-week Friday cadence of Summon/2016 from 2016-10-21 on.
